name: akbun-analysis
description: Codebase analysis skills — map service relationships and business roles into a persistent knowledge store (SQLite graph + LLM wiki + mermaid) and answer structure/impact/risk questions from it with minimal tokens

interface.shortDescription: Codebase service-relationship analysis with a reusable knowledge store (SQLite graph + LLM wiki)
interface.longDescription: Analyzes a codebase once — services, their business roles, and how they connect (HTTP/gRPC calls, events, shared data, cross-repo links) — and persists the result in an OS-standard data directory as a SQLite relationship graph plus an LLM-oriented wiki with mermaid diagrams. Later questions about code structure, service responsibilities, or the impact and risk of a change are answered by reading the stored wiki and querying the graph first, keeping input tokens low; the store is updated incrementally as the code drifts.
defaultPrompt: 이 저장소를 분석해서 서비스 관계 지식 저장소를 만들어줘
